how: Learn QIGONG in Shanghai runs English-language Five Element qigong classes on Tuesdays and Thursdays for complete beginners, plus intensive and private sessions.
Allianz Jinqiao Arena in Pudong hosts leagues and tournaments for netball among other sports, with courts rented by the hour.
Allianz Jinqiao Arena in Pudong is listed as hosting leagues and tournaments for lawn bowls among other sports.
Allianz Jinqiao Arena in Pudong hosts lacrosse sessions during the winter months alongside baseball, hockey and ultimate frisbee.
Make in China runs one-off three-hour handicraft workshops in weaving and macrame with all materials supplied to take home.
Lie Huo Game Center on Jiangning Lu is a multi-floor retro arcade with hundreds of 1990s and 2000s fighting, shoot-em-up and rhythm cabinets and is open until 2am.
Luyuan Fishing Leisure Center in southern Pudong charges a flat day fee for pond fishing with rented bamboo rods and bait on sale.
Official World Cube Association competitions are held in Shanghai several times a year (for example More Than One Cube Shanghai 2026 in Hongkou), open to any registered competitor.

how: Shanghai Library runs a dedicated Genealogy Hall (jiapu guan) with a large collection of Chinese family genealogies and a knowledge-service platform open to readers.
Alcoholics Anonymous holds daily 12-step meetings in English-language listings at Zhenning Road in Changning, and the Community Center Shanghai offers counselling and family support in Pudong.
Shanghai Natural Wild-Insect Kingdom in Pudong displays live insects, spiders and dragonflies with information sessions on basic insect knowledge, open daily.

how: Talking China offers short fast-track courses of 3 to 30 hours in Chinese calligraphy, Chinese painting and paper cutting for foreign learners at its Changning studio.
UnTour Shanghai runs guided small-group street food walking tours (Night Eats and Street Eats Breakfast) through local food stalls, with English-speaking guides.
Expat volunteer groups such as Shanghai Sunrise place volunteers in English tutoring and scholarship-student support roles, and one-off entrepreneurship mentoring evenings have been listed.

Alliance Francaise Shanghai (Shanghai French Training Centre) teaches general and specialised French to adults in term courses, with an autumn term from 12 September to 22 November 2026 and free online level tests.

how: GEOS Language and Culture Center in Xuhui, established in 1973, teaches courses in Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean on weekdays and weekends.
Doro (Duole Zhonggu Yanghang) is a vintage watch shop on Xinle Road stocking mid-century Omega, Rolex, Longines and other watches with documented provenance.
Chinese university MOOC platforms such as China University MOOC (icourse163) offer free online courses to any resident; online format with no Shanghai-specific venue.
Big E Entertainment Center in Pudong has billiards tables alongside air hockey, foosball, laser tag and mini golf, and several sports bars (Big Bamboo, Koala Bar) have pool tables.
Sneaker Con Shanghai is an annual sneaker trading convention at the Shanghai Expo Center with over 200 vendors (11th edition in December 2020), and the city has a dense streetwear retail scene.
